FEAT4-ST-021.title: Construct External Reference Links (State Boards, Research)
FEAT4-ST-021.description: Extend provider detail logic to generate external reference URLs including state medical board pages and research site links based on provider metadata.

FEAT4-ST-022.title: Integrate URL Validation for Provider Links
FEAT4-ST-022.description: Validate all constructed external links using the URL guardian to ensure accuracy, safety, and reachability before returning to the user.

FEAT4-ST-023.title: Handle Missing or Incomplete NPI Data Gracefully
FEAT4-ST-023.description: Implement fallback handling for incomplete NPI responses including null-safe mapping, default values, and partial response returns without system failure.

FEAT4-ST-024.title: Add Integration Test for End-to-End Provider Detail Flow
FEAT4-ST-024.description: Create integration test covering full flow from tool invocation through facade to provider_detail_service and external API, validating response structure and link outputs.
